{{Quote|You're good, but I'm better.|Verena Talos|<ref name="Return to Hoth" />}}
'''Verena Talos''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] soldier and [[operative]] that was aligned with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. She aided the [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] [[MHD-19/Legends|MHD-19]] and the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Sniper/Legends|marksman]] [[Loku Kanoloa/Legends|Loku Kanoloa]] in trying to evacuate some colonists from the Empire, they returned to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] forced them to evacuate.<ref name="Return to Hoth" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|No one ever learns everything they need, but I have come close.|Verena Talos|<ref name="Return to Hoth" />}}
Verena Talos participated in various operations in the past and had participated in the Battle of Hoth. She was among those who was forced to evacuate from [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] by the Galactic Empire as a result of the disastrous ground battle, which also made her very eager to exact revenge when the time came. She later aided some colonists, returned to Hoth with her comrades [[Loku Kanoloa/Legends|Loku Kanoloa]] and [[MHD-19/Legends|MHD-19]] shortly after the evacuation.<ref name="Return to Hoth" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I was born gifted; I trained to become the best.|Verena Talos|<ref name="Return to Hoth" />}}
Talos was a skilled combatant, having engaged in several vital operations. She also had a lot of hate for the Galactic Empire for the destruction of Echo Base, and was eager to exact revenge on them for it when the time came.<ref name="Return to Hoth" />

==Behind the scenes==
Verena Talos is one of three hero characters in the [[Return to Hoth (expansion)|''Return to Hoth'']] expansion pack for the tactical land-based RPG game ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]'' by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].
